title: Thread Border Router Packet Loss
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thread:router
| stats avg(packet_loss_pct) as avg_packet_loss_pct, max(packet_loss_pct) as max_packet_loss_pct by border_router
| where avg_packet_loss_pct>2 OR max_packet_loss_pct>5
| sort - avg_packet_loss_pct
description: Uses Thread border-router telemetry telemetry to monitor mesh packet loss at the router edge in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for routers that are introducing reliability problems, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Thread border-router telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Border-router table of average and max packet loss.
grandmaExplanation: It produces mesh packet loss at the router edge so you can spot routers that are introducing reliability problems before it becomes annoying.
